text: CUDA Toolkit provides a development environment for building GPU-accelerated applications
quote: The NVIDIA® CUDA® Toolkit provides a development environment for creating high-performance, GPU-accelerated applications.

text: CUDA Toolkit includes GPU-accelerated libraries, debugging and optimization tools, a C/C++ compiler, and a runtime library
quote: The toolkit includes GPU-accelerated libraries, debugging and optimization tools, a C/C++ compiler, and a runtime library.

text: CUDA Tile C++ lets developers write tile kernels in C++ on top of the CUDA Tile IR specification
quote: CUDA Tile C++ is an expression of the CUDA Tile programming model in C++. It's built on top of the CUDA Tile IR specification and allows you to write tile kernels in C++.

text: cuTile Python lets developers write tile kernels in Python on top of the CUDA Tile IR specification
quote: cuTile Python is an expression of the CUDA Tile programming model in Python. It is built on top of the CUDA Tile IR specification and allows you to write tile kernels in Python.

text: Nsight Compute and Nsight Systems tools help developers profile and optimize application performance
quote: NVIDIA Nsight Compute and Nsight System suite of tools designed to help developers optimize and increase performance of their applications.

text: CUDA 13.4 adds CUDA support for the Windows on Arm ecosystem
quote: CUDA 13.4 brings a host of advancements to the platform including CUDA support for the Windows on Arm ecosystem

text: CUDA containers, GPU-accelerated SDKs and AI models can be downloaded from NGC
quote: CUDA containers are available to download from NGC™—along with other NVIDIA GPU-accelerated SDKs and AI models—to help accelerate your applications.

text: DLSS Multi Frame Generation uses AI to generate up to five frames per rendered frame to boost FPS
quote: Powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series and fifth-generation Tensor Cores, new DLSS Multi Frame Generation boosts FPS by using AI to generate up to five frames per rendered frame.

text: Dynamic Multi Frame Generation adjusts the frame multiplier automatically to maximize smoothness across games and scenes
quote: Dynamic Multi Frame Generation maximizes smoothness by dynamically generating up to five frames per rendered frame.

text: DLSS Super Resolution uses AI to output higher-resolution frames from lower-resolution input
quote: Boosts performance by using AI to output higher-resolution frames from a lower-resolution input.

text: NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features and AI models
quote: With the NVIDIA app you can update hundreds of games to use the latest DLSS features including Multi Frame Generation, and the newest AI models for DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation, and Ray Reconstruction.

text: DLSS Ray Reconstruction replaces hand-tuned denoisers with an AI network that generates higher-quality pixels between sampled rays
quote: DLSS replaces hand-tuned denoisers with an NVIDIA supercomputer-trained AI network that generates higher-quality pixels between sampled rays.

text: DLAA provides AI-based anti-aliasing at native resolution using DLSS Super Resolution technology
quote: Provides higher image quality with an AI-based anti-aliasing technique. DLAA uses the same Super Resolution technology developed for DLSS, constructing a more realistic, high-quality image at native resolution.

text: DLSS 5 3D-Guided Neural Rendering uses AI to add lifelike lighting and materials to game scenes
quote: DLSS 5 introduces 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, which uses AI to infuse game scenes with lifelike lighting and materials on GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs.

text: Game developers can tune the final DLSS neural rendering output to match their artistic vision
quote: Developers tune the final output for each game to bring their artistic vision to life.

text: Reflex optimizes the graphics pipeline to reduce latency and improve responsiveness in competitive games
quote: Reflex technologies optimize the graphics pipeline for ultimate responsiveness, providing faster target acquisition, quicker reaction times, and improved aim precision in competitive games.

text: Blackwell architecture enables real-time path tracing using fourth-gen RT Cores and neural rendering accelerated by Tensor Cores
quote: The NVIDIA Blackwell architecture unlocks the game-changing realism of path tracing. Experience cinematic quality visuals at unprecedented speed powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series with fourth-gen RT Cores and breakthrough neural rendering tec

text: Fourth-generation RT Cores deliver up to 2x faster ray tracing with physically accurate shadows, reflections and refractions
quote: Fourth-generation RT Cores deliver up to 2x faster ray tracing, rendering photorealistic scenes with physically accurate shadows, reflections, and refractions.

text: RTX Mega Geometry speeds up BVH building to allow up to 100x more ray-traced triangles
quote: RTX Mega Geometry dramatically increases the geometric detail possible in ray-traced scenes, accelerating BVH building to enable up to 100x more ray-traced triangles with better performance.

text: RTX Neural Shaders SDK lets developers train shader data and accelerate neural representations on Tensor Cores at runtime
quote: The RTX Neural Shaders SDK lets developers train shader data on an RTX PRO workstation and accelerate neural representations with NVIDIA Tensor Cores at runtime.

text: RTX Neural Shaders bring small neural networks into shaders for radiance caching and texture and material compression
quote: RTX Neural Shaders bring small neural networks into programmable shaders, unlocking new techniques for radiance caching, texture and material compression

text: RTX 5090 uses the Blackwell architecture with 32 GB of GDDR7 memory
quote: The GeForce RTX 5090 is powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and equipped with 32 GB of super-fast GDDR7 memory, so you can do it all.

text: Fifth-gen Tensor Cores deliver up to 3x deep learning throughput and support FP4, FP6, FP8, FP16, BF16 and TF32 precision
quote: Fifth-generation Tensor Cores deliver up to 3x higher throughput for deep learning, with new FP4 support for massive performance gains alongside TF32, BF16, FP16, FP8, and FP6 precision.

text: Second-gen FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates LLM prototyping and inference in frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch
quote: A second-generation FP8 Transformer Engine... accelerates LLM prototyping, inference, and AI development across frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch.

text: NVIDIA Broadcast and the ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder provide AI video enhancement and hardware encoding
quote: Enhance Any Video with AI. NVIDIA Broadcast and ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder

text: NVIDIA Studio provides creator tools and technology to accelerate creative workflows
quote:
Accelerate Your Creativity

NVIDIA Studio creator tools and technology

text: Built-in AI processors power AI features on Windows PCs
quote: Thanks to built-in AI processors, you get world-leading AI technology powering your Windows PC.

text: GPU powers interactive design workflows with immediate feedback and shorter iteration cycles
quote: they power interactive design workflows with immediate feedback and dramatically shorter iteration cycles.
